summary: Core Telephony exposes the home cellular carrier, eSIM provisioning, subscriber information and cellular data access for iPhone and iPad hardware. BifrOSt PC has no cellular modem support and no SDK API for carrier or SIM data, so there is no counterpart to map to.

features.note: Cellular carrier data needs a modem; BifrOSt PC is a Wi-Fi and Ethernet desktop (springboard/src/net/wifi.rs)
Carrier eSIM install is Apple hardware and carrier-specific
No SIM hardware path in the PC build
Cellular subscriber identity has no PC equivalent
Networking on PC goes through netd (springboard/src/net/), which has no cellular path
Follows from the feature rows above
